title: It that what we call, "Watch mommy's favorite shows.." I have the opposite problem of needing to swallow my tongue while my eldest belts every top 40
summary: It that what we call, "Watch mommy's favorite shows.." I have the opposite problem of needing to swallow my tongue while my eldest belts every top 40 pop tune 24 hours a day. I feel like I am being a bad parent letting him love pop.
author: Greg McVerry
body_html:
It that what we call, "Watch mommy's favorite shows.." I have the opposite problem of needing to swallow my tongue while my eldest belts every top 40 pop tune 24 hours a day.

I feel like I am being a bad parent letting him love pop.
